title: Client holding statement (NSE / BSE API, JSON)
purpose: The trading member's own demat accounts (pool, own, client unpaid, client collateral, margin and MTF pledge, early pay-in…), each account and ISIN with its NSE account type and the member's own client code, PAN and name (NSE/INSP/55039, NSE/INSP/55380). Not clients' holdings in their own accounts.
linked: Written from the day's CDSL statement of holding, for the firm's demat accounts tagged in Settings → Firm demat accounts; not made while an account of no client is untagged (firmdemats.go)
